bib.title: LLaSM: Large Language and Speech Model

read.skipped: figures (1-7) are images; their text is not in the cache, only captions and the Figure 4/5 caption text

question: Can an LLM be given the ability to follow speech-and-language instructions end to end, cheaply, by reusing a pretrained speech encoder and LLM?
hypothesis: Feeding speech embeddings directly to the LLM (no ASR cascade) avoids information loss and ASR errors and gives a more natural interface.
contributions: A speech-language multi-modal model that understands and follows speech-language instructions.
LLaSM-Audio-Instructions, a large Chinese and English speech-text cross-modal instruction-following dataset.

method.summary: Whisper encodes audio to embeddings; a modal adaptor maps them into the text embedding space of Chinese-LLAMA2-7B; audio and text embeddings are interleaved. Stage 1 trains only the adaptor on public ASR data; stage 2 trains adaptor and LLM on TTS-synthesised speech instructions.

datasets.name: Aishell, LibriSpeech, Magicdata, Primewords (ASR)
datasets.source: public ASR datasets, English and Chinese
datasets.preprocessing: each sample formatted as (simple ASR instruction, audio, text label); instruction randomly placed before or after the audio tokens; target is the transcript

datasets.name: LLaSM-Audio-Instructions
datasets.source: human turns from WizardLM (80k conv, 160k samples), ShareGPT (23k conv, 155k samples), GPT-4-LLM (96k conv, 192k samples), voiced with Microsoft Azure TTS API
datasets.preprocessing: removed conversations unsuitable for vocalisation (code, many symbols, URLs, non-readable text); chatbot answers filtered again to drop those without valuable information; multi-round dialogues concatenated with EOS

other.prompt_format: Llama-2 chat format with a system prompt

models.name: Whisper
models.architecture: speech encoder, frozen in both stages

training.objective: predict text label (stage 1: transcript; stage 2: chatbot response); loss only on response tokens

other.stage_1: Whisper and LLM frozen, only modal adaptor trained
other.stage_2: Whisper frozen, modal adaptor and LLM trained jointly

inference.prompting: Llama-2 chat format; SYSTEM = 'You are a helpful language and speech assistant. You are able to understand the speech content that the user provides, and assist the user with a variety of tasks using natural language.'

eval.protocol: qualitative examples only (Figure 7); no quantitative evaluation

results.claim: LLaSM responds to Chinese and English speech directly, without ASR preprocessing, shown only through example conversations; no metrics.
results.quote: LLaSM can directly process speech inputs, which improves its execution efficiency

limits: No quantitative evaluation: Section 4 is a paragraph pointing at example conversations (Figure 7); no ASR WER, no benchmark, no baseline comparison (cascade or SpeechGPT).
No training hyperparameters, hardware, compute, adaptor architecture, Whisper size, or training sizes of the ASR data are given.
Speech inputs in the instruction data are synthetic TTS (Azure), not real human speech; model outputs are text only, no speech generation.
The claim that cascades lose paralinguistic information and add ASR errors is asserted, not tested.
Future work: add vision encoder to combine vision and audio.
